note: What a server sends about a unit's health bar. The header names the unit.

bits.name: show
bits.note: Set to show the bar, clear to hide it. Clear in everything observed.

bits.name: changeType
bits.note: Set where the bar's type changes; a client reads the type and side below only then. Clear in everything observed.

bits.name: unknown
bits.note: A client does not read these. Clear in everything observed.

fields.name: barType
fields.note: Which sort of bar: 1 a unit's, 2 a champion's. A client reads it only where changeType is set; a server observed sends it either way, 49 in everything observed.

fields.name: side
fields.note: The side that sees the change, or 0 for every side.
